cadences.description: Boyajian's Star, the F-type star with irregular dimming up to 22%. GBT S-band (2.27 GHz), full 6-scan ON/OFF cadence (scans 0031-0036, MJD 57898).

First known interstellar object in the Solar System, with non-gravitational acceleration and an extreme aspect ratio. GBT S-band (2.27 GHz), full 6-scan cadence (scans 0011-0016, MJD 58100). The .h5 file names do not say OFF, but the archive's .fil copies label 0012/0014/0016 OFF and their RA/Dec are offset from the tracked object.

Ultracool dwarf 40 light-years away with seven temperate terrestrial planets (three in the habitable zone) in a resonance chain. GBT 2.16 GHz (compute node blc00), 4-scan ON/OFF/ON/OFF cadence (scans 0015-0018, MJD 57807). The session moved to 3.06 GHz after scan 0018, so there is no third ON at this frequency.

cadences.description: Massive molecular cloud complex near Sgr A* at the Milky Way's core, a Schelling point for pan-galactic beacons. GBT S-band (2.27 GHz). No cadence: scans 0013 (~1 min) and 0014 (~20 min) point at the same RA/Dec, and the archive has no OFF scan for this session. Nothing here can be sky-localized, so every candidate is UNTESTED.

Epsilon Eridani (10.5 ly), the closest young solar analog with a planet and a debris belt. GBT S-band (2.30 GHz), full ABACAD cadence on MJD 57635: GJ 144 scans 0003/0005/0007, with HIP 15477, HIP 15480 and HIP 15598 as the three OFF pointings. Before 2026-10-16 this entry paired GJ 144 with a scan of LHS 292 taken ~207 days later.

cadences.target_name: Kepler-992b vs. Kepler-738b (L-Band Water Hole 1.475 GHz)
cadences.description: L-band observations centered at 1475 MHz inside the 'Water Hole' (between the 1420 MHz H I line and the 1665 MHz OH lines). 4-scan cadence on MJD 58202: Kepler-992b scans 0010/0012 as ON, interleaved with Kepler-738b scans 0011/0013 as OFF. The session moved to Kepler-1039b after scan 0013, so there is no third ON.
